papers.summary: DisMUSE develops distributed singular-spectrum optimization with Muon-style orthogonalized momentum, variance reduction, Newton-Schulz approximation, and low-rank momentum communication.
papers.relevance: Directly matches spectral optimization, Newton-Schulz methods, distributed training, and communication-quality tradeoffs.

evidence.quote: communication-efficient variant based on low-rank (LR) momentum transmission

papers.title: DisMUSE: An Efficient Distributed Singular-Spectrum-Based Optimization Approach with Theoretical Convergence Guarantee

papers.summary: Analyzes how finite Newton-Schulz depth changes rank selection and can cause matrix-factorization trajectories to bypass early saddles.
papers.relevance: Strong theoretical match for Newton-Schulz optimization, rank dynamics, and low-rank training geometry.

evidence.quote: the number of Newton-Schulz steps can change the rank selected during the early stages of training

papers.title: Finite Spectral Depth Controls Gaussian Entrance Rank and Avoidance of the First Gradient-Flow Saddle

papers.summary: ResQAdam combines BF16 residual momentum, low-rank adaptive states, and a sign residual update for quantization-aware LLM training.
papers.relevance: Directly addresses optimizer-state memory, throughput, quality, and comparisons with AdamW, GaLore, and LDAdam.

evidence.quote: It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close to AdamW in most settings, and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.
Total peak memory is defined as the maximum GPU memory consumed during training, encompassing weights, activations, gradients, and optimizer states.

papers.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training

papers.summary: GEAR uses tangent-normal geometry and normal-spectrum estimates to evolve LoRA ranks toward task-relevant directions.
papers.relevance: Directly addresses dynamic rank allocation, spectral information, and the geometry of LoRA optimization.

evidence.quote: the leading normal singular directions yield the locally optimal rank expansion

papers.title: From What Is Used to What Is Missing: Rethinking Dynamic Rank in LoRA

papers.summary: Studies singular-spectrum and subspace dynamics of LoRA updates in supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, attributing differences partly to group-mean baseline subtraction.
papers.relevance: Highly relevant to understanding how training objectives and optimization affect LoRA spectra and effective rank.

evidence.quote: Tracking the singular spectrum and subspaces of LoRA updates

papers.title: Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Analyzes frozen and periodically resampled LoRA factors as stochastic projections and relates adaptation rank to gradient signal-to-noise ratio.
papers.relevance: Relevant to LoRA optimization geometry, rank-dependent learning rates, convergence, and communication efficiency.

evidence.quote: the adaptation rank $r$ directly governs the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the perturbed gradients

papers.title: Stochastic Projections and Rank-Aware Learning Rates for Federated LoRA

papers.summary: HiLo and Spar reduce distributed LoRA synchronization by disseminating compressed gradients and replaying local optimizer updates with spectral rank allocation.
papers.relevance: Directly studies communication cost, spectral compression, adaptive rank, and quality at scale.

evidence.quote: maintains learning quality close to full synchronization while transmitting as little as 1.6% of the adapter bytes

papers.title: Train High, Ship Low: Efficient LoRA Synchronization for Distributed On-Policy Post-Training

papers.summary: BiMuon introduces Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates into stochastic bilevel optimization and addresses spectral imbalance in bilevel geometry.
papers.relevance: Matches interests in matrix optimization, Muon, spectral geometry, and optimization complexity.

evidence.quote: the lower-level (LL) problem curvature can induce significant spectral imbalance in the upper-level (UL) geometry

papers.title: BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach

papers.summary: Studies how learning rules, weight decay, and optimizer choices steer grokking circuits between memorization and generalization, affecting circuit size and compressibility.
papers.relevance: Directly connects optimization and regularization to memorization, generalization, robustness, and effective structural complexity.

evidence.quote: Learning rule choice thus steers circuit size, trading robustness against compressibility and transfer speed

papers.title: Grokking Can Be Steered: Selecting Desirable Solutions By Choice Of Learning Rule

papers.summary: SaMA generalizes Kronecker-based adaptation to obtain higher practical rank under a fixed parameter budget and reduce optimizer-unfriendly invariances.
papers.relevance: Relevant to low-rank PEFT, rank scaling, optimization geometry, and parameter-efficiency tradeoffs.

evidence.quote: its invariance manifold induces flat directions in the loss landscape, creating an optimization bottleneck for adaptive optimizers

papers.title: SaMA: Morpho Adaptation via Asymmetric Expansion of Kronecker Product

papers.summary: Uses activation-angle concentration and SVD components to select rank reductions in LLM adaptation using forward-only passes.
papers.relevance: Addresses singular-value-based compressibility, adaptation quality, peak memory, and speed without gradient-based search.

evidence.quote: our forward-only search then efficiently identifies the weight matrix with the highest dispersion that merits rank reduction

papers.title: Efficient LLM Adaptation with Forward-Only Passes

papers.summary: FedLoVA trains LoRA on query and value projections locally while communicating only value adapters to reduce federated communication.
papers.relevance: Directly covers LoRA, communication efficiency, convergence, and quality tradeoffs in LLM fine-tuning.

evidence.quote: This approach reduces communication overhead while improving convergence efficiency.

papers.title: FedLoVA: Value-Only Aggregation for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models

papers.summary: SCALAR adapts LLMs using learned scalar coefficients over fixed task-calibrated directions, reducing trainable parameters, peak memory, and throughput cost relative to LoRA.
papers.relevance: Strong practical match for memory-efficient PEFT and quality-memory-throughput tradeoffs.

evidence.quote: SCALAR achieves performance comparable to LoRA with substantially fewer trainable parameters, lower peak training memory, and higher throughput.

papers.title: Direction or Magnitude? Learning Scalars over Task-Calibrated Directions

papers.summary: Defines behavioral rate as the compressed adapter size needed to preserve fine-tuning behavior and studies how it varies across datasets and frozen base models.
papers.relevance: Directly addresses behavioral compressibility, adapter compression, singular directions, and robustness to corrupted training data.

evidence.quote: fine-tuning compressibility is a property of the dataset--receiver pair rather than of the dataset alone

papers.title: The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information

papers.summary: Studies temporary weight decay in Muon-trained Transformers across model scales and explains delayed effects through weight-norm dynamics.
papers.relevance: Relevant to spectral or norm-based regularization, Muon optimization, and scale-dependent training behavior.

evidence.quote: temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers

papers.title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining

limitations: Most evidence comes from abstracts, several of which are truncated.
Only ResQAdam received detailed inspection; experimental controls and measured tradeoffs for the other papers remain unverified.
Code availability and reproducibility were not checked.
X analysis was disabled, so no attention signal is included.
